name: Mega Evolution
author: eduardocalafell
description: In-battle Mega Evolution for Kanto/Johto Pokemon, done the honest way: a TEMPORARY battle transform (not a permanent evolution) that reverts when the battle ends, reusing the engine's own Transform machinery. Covers all 21 Gen 1/2 mega forms (Venusaur, Charizard X & Y, Blastoise, Gyarados, Gengar, Tyranitar, Scizor, ...). Press SELECT (Tab) in the battle action menu to Mega Evolve your active Pokemon, with a proper transformation animation. Gated by a minimum level and an optional battle cooldown; once per battle. Charizard and Mewtwo pick X or Y in the options. Depends on gen2_dex (pins the Pokedex bound; provides the Dark/Steel types).
